description: Hyperliquid deposits, withdrawals, transfers and vault events ACROSS wallets, newest first, with `wallet` and `amount_usd` (USD) on every row; `min_usd` keeps the large ones (most events are small transfers). A transfer between two wallets is one row per affected wallet with the same `hash`. Without `wallet` the window defaults to the last 24 hours and is at most 31 days. `order=asc` follows the feed: pass each `nextCursor` back and stop on an empty page. One wallet's own ledger is also hl_wallet_activity view=ledger. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/ledger.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, verbatim. It pins the call that returned it: send the same `order`, filters, `start` and `end` again, or the call is refused.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC upper bound. Default: now. A window wider than 31 days is refused unless `wallet` is given.

event_type.description: One ledger event type; an unknown value is refused, not answered with an empty list.

min_usd.description: Smallest absolute `amount_usd`, 0 or more. Default 0: no floor.

order.description: `desc` (default, newest first) or `asc`, oldest first: the mode for FOLLOWING the feed. Pass each `nextCursor` back verbatim and stop on an EMPTY page, not on a null cursor (an `asc` page with rows always carries one). A row written late with an older key is not seen by a poller already past it: re-read a small overlap with `start`. A page can hold fewer than `limit` rows and still carry a cursor (duplicates are dropped after the read).

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC lower bound. Default: the 24 hours before `end`, unless `wallet` is given.

wallet.description: One wallet, 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case. With it there is no default window and no 31-day cap.
